data.name: SQL_SBO_EXX_SIRE_ASISTENTE_MASIVO
data.value:
CREATE PROCEDURE SBO_EXX_SIRE_ASISTENTE_MASIVO @TIPO VARCHAR(1), @PROCESO VARCHAR(1), @PERIODO VARCHAR(1) AS BEGIN SET NOCOUNT ON;
-- Cuando tipo es C (Compras) IF @TIPO = 'C' BEGIN -- Cuando proceso es '-' IF @PROCESO = '-' BEGIN SELECT (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(T2.DocEntry AS VARCHAR(50)), '') = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS Sel, T0.Code AS BPLId, T1.GlblLocNum, T1.BPLName AS BPLName, T0.U_EXX_APIS, T0.U_EXX_USER, T0.U_EXX_PASS, T0.U_EXX_CLID, T0.U_EXX_CLSE, ISNULL(CAST(T2.DocEntry AS VARCHAR(50)), '') AS DocEntry FROM [@EXX_SIRE_APIS] T0 INNER JOIN OBPL T1 ON T0.Code = T1.BPLId LEFT JOIN [@EXX_SIRE_COMP] T2 ON T0.Code = T2.U_EXX_BPLID AND ISNULL(T2.Canceled, 'N') = 'N' AND T2.U_EXX_PERIODO = @PERIODO WHERE ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_APIS, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_USER, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_PASS, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_CLID, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_CLSE, '') <> ''; END -- Cuando proceso es distinto de '-' (p. ej. '0') ELSE BEGIN SELECT (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(T2.DocEntry AS VARCHAR(50)), '') = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS Sel, T0.Code AS BPLId, T1.GlblLocNum, T1.BPLName AS BPLName, T0.U_EXX_APIS, T0.U_EXX_USER, T0.U_EXX_PASS, T0.U_EXX_CLID, T0.U_EXX_CLSE, ISNULL(CAST(T2.DocEntry AS VARCHAR(50)), '') AS DocEntry FROM [@EXX_SIRE_APIS] T0 INNER JOIN OBPL T1 ON T0.Code = T1.BPLId LEFT JOIN [@EXX_SIRE_COMP] T2 ON T0.Code = T2.U_EXX_BPLID AND ISNULL(T2.Canceled, 'N') = 'N' AND T2.U_EXX_PERIODO = @PERIODO WHERE ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_APIS, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_USER, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_PASS, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_CLID, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_CLSE, '') <> '' AND T2.U_EXX_ESTADO = @PROCESO; END END -- Cuando tipo es V (Ventas) ELSE IF @TIPO = 'V' BEGIN -- Cuando proceso es '-' IF @PROCESO = '-' BEGIN SELECT (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(T2.DocEntry AS VARCHAR(50)), '') = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS Sel, T0.Code AS BPLId, T1.GlblLocNum, T1.BPLName AS BPLName, T0.U_EXX_APIS, T0.U_EXX_USER, T0.U_EXX_PASS, T0.U_EXX_CLID, T0.U_EXX_CLSE, ISNULL(CAST(T2.DocEntry AS VARCHAR(50)), '') AS DocEntry FROM [@EXX_SIRE_APIS] T0 INNER JOIN OBPL T1 ON T0.Code = T1.BPLId LEFT JOIN [@EXX_SIRE_VENT] T2 ON T0.Code = T2.U_EXX_BPLID AND ISNULL(T2.Canceled, 'N') = 'N' AND T2.U_EXX_PERIODO = @PERIODO WHERE ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_APIS, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_USER, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_PASS, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_CLID, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_CLSE, '') <> ''; END -- Cuando proceso es distinto de '-' (p. ej. '0') ELSE BEGIN SELECT (CASE WHEN ISNULL(CAST(T2.DocEntry AS VARCHAR(50)), '') = '' THEN 'N' ELSE 'Y' END) AS Sel, T0.Code AS BPLId, T1.GlblLocNum, T1.BPLName AS BPLName, T0.U_EXX_APIS, T0.U_EXX_USER, T0.U_EXX_PASS, T0.U_EXX_CLID, T0.U_EXX_CLSE, ISNULL(CAST(T2.DocEntry AS VARCHAR(50)), '') AS DocEntry FROM [@EXX_SIRE_APIS] T0 INNER JOIN OBPL T1 ON T0.Code = T1.BPLId LEFT JOIN [@EXX_SIRE_VENT] T2 ON T0.Code = T2.U_EXX_BPLID AND ISNULL(T2.Canceled, 'N') = 'N' AND T2.U_EXX_PERIODO = @PERIODO WHERE ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_APIS, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_USER, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_PASS, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_CLID, '') <> '' AND ISNULL(T0.U_EXX_CLSE, '') <> '' AND T2.U_EXX_ESTADO = @PROCESO; END END END;
